sections.title: What Finny is
sections.body: Finny is a personal tool to record your income, expenses, budgets and savings goals. It is not financial, tax or investment advice.

sections.title: Access and payment
sections.body: Access is a yearly subscription paid by Bit, outside the app. An admin approves each account by hand. Until approval the app stays locked. When the year ends, the app locks again and your data is kept until you renew.

sections.title: Your data
sections.body: The data you enter belongs to you. It is stored on secure servers and shown only to you. You can delete your account in More; this deletes all your data for good.

sections.title: Your account
sections.body: Keep your password private. You are responsible for what is entered in your account.

sections.title: Changes
sections.body: These terms may change. The version you agree to at sign-up is saved with your account.
